title: プロジェクトデザインⅢ(永野紳一郎研究室)
subtitle: Design Project III (Nagano Shinichirou)
keywords: Air environment 2.Spread of fire fire 3.Recycling 4.Ventilation, the ventilation 5.Air quality
educationalGoal: What a prediction analyzes air and the heat accompanied with the change of the outside world climatic condition, the movement of the pollutant to control the residence environment of the building space and I aim for what I come to be able to evaluate and wear an analysis technology by the numerical analysis technique, and air environment comes to be able to evaluate.
advice: "The prior quarter" 1.According to "the project proposal that student planned for each theme," studeny push forward a study. 2.Student settle result as "a project progress report" and announce the result at the first middle presentation of environment origin. 3.Depending on the progress of the theme, student make a study enforcement plan. 4.Student perform theme suggestion to lead to local contribution positively. "Rear term" 1.Based on the study enforcement plan which student made for each theme, student push forward a study. 2.Student announce the result at the second middle presentation of environment origin. 3.Student submit result as "a project report" in a mass. 4.Student announce the contents of "the project report" in "project design III exhibition announcement examination committee". 5.Student receive the evaluation of the examination committee by the teacher of environment origin and submit the project design III project report which I revised.
requiredKnowledge: Attending building synthesis practice A, B, and getting an experiment technology and knowledge.

activityGoals.body: To participate in a seminar and can promote project design III for each theme with charge teacher instruction
To report results of research at the middle presentation carried out 2 times of environment origin
To make results of research as a project report and announces it based on it in project design III
To make a project report as the last works and submits it

achievementLevels.ideal: Receiving the evaluation judgment of the excellence from a teacher to examine in middle announcement and project design III exhibition announcement examination committee, and the contents of the project report having been equal to a purpose appropriately. In addition, participating in a seminar positively through whole year, and the level that could give a presentation at the meeting having been able to propel a project.
achievementLevels.standard: Receiving a good evaluation judgment from a teacher to examine in middle announcement and project design III exhibition announcement examination committee, and the contents of the project report having been equal to a purpose. In addition, participating in a seminar positively through whole year, and having been able to promote a project in the range of uniformity.

lessons.content: The student becoming able to accomplish the theme that I set in project design III over the rear term.
